newsitem.title: FINLAND: Partek suspended at own request - bourse.
newsitem.headline: Partek suspended at own request - bourse.

text.p: Trade in shares of Finnish construction materials and cargo handling equipment group Partek Oy Ab was suspended on Tuesday at the company's own request, the Helsinki stock exchange said in a statement.
A Partek spokeswoman said by telephone that the company would release a statement shortly and that it would hold a news conference at 1245 GMT. She did not elaborate.

Trade in Swedish vehicles maker Kalmar Industries has been suspended on the Stockholm bourse since last Friday pending the release due later today of its interim report. Analysts have speculated that Partek's Sisu unit may acquire Kalmar.
